jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day To support the extended responsibilities of the Sales Guidance & Enablement team within Siemens Energy Grid Technologies, there is an immediate business need for a Partner Enablement Manager (f/m/d) in Germany. This role is crucial in driving structured sales guidance and enablement strategies for our global network of partners, including agents and distributors, to accelerate market reach and align with strategic growth objectives. To address this business aim, this role focuses on partner sales guidance, training program development, and performance enablement.These core areas directly support Grid Technologies' commercial success by equipping external channel partners with the necessary tools, technical-commercial knowledge, and compliance frameworks to represent our portfolio effectively. Given the focus on partner enablement and channel sales strategy, the ideal candidate will have extensive experience in partner management within the energy or industrial sector, strong communication skills, and a proven track record of designing and executing enablement programs.How You’ll Make an Impact * Develop and implement comprehensive sales guidance and enablement programs specifically tailored for indirect sales channels, including agents and distributors.* Create, update, and distribute sales toolkits, product documentation, and value proposition materials to enhance partner effectiveness.* Conduct regular workshops and training sessions (technical and commercial) to ensure partners are fully aligned with Siemens Energy Grid Technologies' portfolio and standards.* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitoring frameworks to evaluate partner sales performance and enablement effectiveness.* Act as the primary interface between internal sales/product teams and external partners to resolve complex enablement queries and facilitate knowledge transfer.* Support partner onboarding processes and ensure continuous compliance with Siemens Energy's business conduct guidelines and regulatory requirements.* Analyze partner feedback and market trends to continuously refine enablement strategies and identify new commercial opportunities.* Collaborate with the Innovation and Market Enablement team to align partner activities with global sales strategies and product launch roadmaps.Certifications* Certified Sales Enablement Professional (CSEP)* Project Management Professional (PMP)What You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field of study.* Several years of professional experience in partner management, channel sales, or sales enablement, preferably within the energy, grid infrastructure, or heavy industrial sectors.* Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German or other European languages is highly advantageous.* Experience in channel management, partner relationships, and sales enablement.* Strong commercial and technical understanding, including portfolio and market knowledge.* Skilled in training design, presentation, and facilitation.* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interculturaAbout the TeamOur Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us.
